title: The Alien Anatomy of Octopuses
hook: An octopus' heart stops every time it swims. How?
script: An octopus' heart stops every time it swims. How? With three hearts, two for gills, one for the body, swimming halts the main heart. Its blue blood, rich in hemocyanin, thrives in deep-sea cold. Imagine a network of blood vessels two to three times its length. This alien design lets it crawl where others swim. Blood chemistry so strange it can cause allergies in humans.
